# Blora Design

> Token-driven, accessible, zero-dependency Web UI design system (2.0 alpha).

## System

Blora Design 2.0 prefers native HTML semantics for primitives and Composite Custom Elements for structure-sensitive controls. Design Tokens (DTCG JSON → CSS) drive visuals. Light/dark, RTL, and WCAG 2.2 AA are project goals. Core package has zero runtime third-party dependencies.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add @bloret-crew/blora-design@latest
```

```js
import "@bloret-crew/blora-design/blora.css";
import "@bloret-crew/blora-design/auto";
import { createTableController, message, notify } from "@bloret-crew/blora-design";
// tree-shake friendly subpaths:
// import { createTableController } from "@bloret-crew/blora-design/table";
```

Use `.blora-button[data-variant="primary"]` — not 1.x `.blora-btn--primary` / global `Blora.init()`.
Feedback: `message` / `message.success` (pill) + `notify` (cards). **No toast API.**

## Key entry points

- Package: `@bloret-crew/blora-design` (`2.0.0` Stable)
- `./auto` — register the default Composite CE surface (range, date/time, search, transfer, accordion/collapse, command, segmented, tabs, select, dialog)
- `./icons-full` (`icons-full.global.js`) — opt-in: registers **every** Lucide icon into `createBloraIcon`, so any icon name works without a framework rebuild. Default bundle ships a curated set only (size).
- `./button` `./select` `./dialog` `./table` — JS subpaths (toast **removed**)
- `./blora.global.js` — IIFE CDN global `Blora`
- `./custom-elements.json` / `./component-manifest.json` / `./api-snapshot.json`
- Human guide: `docs/guide.md`
- Contracts: `packages/blora-design/contracts/*.contract.json`
- Contract stability policy: `docs/refactor/contract-stability.md`
- Component matrix: `docs/refactor/component-matrix.md`
- **Remaining work:** `docs/refactor/remaining-work.md` (stop before Beta until checklist)
- Migration standard for projects from any UI framework or hand-written UI: `docs/migration/from-any-ui-to-blora-design.md`
- Historical 1.x → 2.0 mapping: `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md`
- Showcase: `examples/showcase-v2/` (requires full package build)
- Token map CSV: `docs/migration/token-map-v1-v2.csv`
- Alpha install notes: `docs/refactor/alpha-install-notes.md`
- 1.x freeze: `legacy/v1/`, `legacy/showcase-v1.html`
- Add-ons: `@bloret-crew/blora-design-{markdown,thread,qrcode,effects,layout,theming}@latest`

## Architecture

- Prefer native HTML for primitives; use Composite CE for structure-sensitive widgets.
- `createXxxController(root)` remains available for advanced markup and must be destroyed on teardown.
- Table row selection: `data-blora-selectable` (built-in).
- Composite CE is the default structure contract (ADR-015, superseding ADR-013); FA-WC remains staged per form component.
- `sideEffects`: CSS files + `dist/auto.js` only (main entry is tree-shake friendly).

## Prohibitions

- Do not extract visual styles from historical commits or other UI frameworks.
- Do not use `innerHTML` with untrusted strings.
- Do not hardcode colors/spacing/radii/shadows/z-index in component CSS — use tokens.
- Do not add public APIs without updating the contract and regenerating manifests.
- Do not delete `legacy/v1` during 2.0.

## Migration

1.x → 2.0: `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md`. No runtime 1.x compatibility layer.
